findings.current: even if it amounted to no more than a move and a half
findings.defect: Changes a gap of one move or even half a move into one and a half moves.
findings.rationale: 일초 반식 names a move and a half-move as progressively smaller margins, not their sum.
findings.replacement: even if the gap was only one move—or half a move
findings.source: 그 격차가 설령 일초 반식이라 할지라도

findings.current: Jin Taekyung’s figure, standing tall a dozen yards away
findings.defect: Reduces a distance of more than ten jang to roughly one-third its length.
findings.rationale: A jang is approximately three meters.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung’s figure, standing tall over thirty meters away
findings.source: 십여 장 밖에 우뚝 서 있던 진태경의 신형

findings.current: Well, even if you didn’t, you’d have had to tear something off and stick it on to get revenge on the Sword Saint. Right?
findings.defect: Turns “forget about me” into “even if you didn’t,” contradicting the preceding question about wanting strength.
findings.rationale: 나는 몰라도 sets Taekyung aside as an opponent before naming the Sword Saint as the reason the Blood Lord needed the graft.
findings.replacement: Well, forget about me. To get revenge on the Sword Saint, you’d have had to tear something off and stick it on. Right?
findings.source: 하긴, 나는 몰라도 검성에게 복수하려면 뭐라도 떼서 붙여야 했겠지. 안 그래?

findings.current: a thick cloud of dust spreading across a radius of several dozen yards
findings.defect: Shrinks the dust cloud’s radius by converting tens of jang into tens of yards.
findings.rationale: Each jang is about ten feet; 수십여 장 spans hundreds of feet.
findings.replacement: a thick cloud of dust spreading across a radius of hundreds of feet
findings.source: 반경 수십여 장을 뒤덮으며 자욱하게 일어난 먼지구름

findings.current: the opening left by the Blood Lord, who had chased me for a hundred yards while unleashing attack after attack
findings.defect: Reduces the distance the Blood Lord pursued Taekyung by roughly two-thirds.
findings.rationale: 일백여 장 is over one hundred jang, or over three hundred meters.
findings.replacement: the opening left by the Blood Lord, who had chased me for over three hundred meters while unleashing attack after attack
findings.source: 일백여 장이나 나를 뒤쫓으며 공격을 쏟아부은 혈주의 공백을 채운 것은

summary: The draft alters three combat distances, the size of the strength gap, and a taunt about revenge.
